description: 한국철도공사_임대자산 현황 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국철도공사. 한국철도공사의 ‘임대자산 현황’ 데이터는 한국철도공사가 관리 중인 임대 자산의 소재지, 시설명, 계약기간(시작 및 종료), 임대면적(㎡ 기준), 그리고 연간 임대료(부가세 별도) 등. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국철도공사. Its tags are 건물, 유휴부지, 임대, 자산, 소재지. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-08-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
